card.name: Digit 2 and www in references
card.fires_on: The digit 2 when it begins a number inside a confidence interval, patent code, PMID or year, and the www in web addresses after http:// or https://.

modes.label: Leading 2 in numbers
modes.description: The digit 2 starting a number in a confidence interval, patent number, PMID or year.

modes.label: www in URLs
modes.description: The www right after http:// or https:// in a cited web address.

card.writes: It seems to push toward path pieces like ../ and away from word endings, so it adds little clear meaning.
card.plain: It lights up on a starting 2 in numbers and on www in web links, mostly in citations and reference lists.
